title: Market Research Analyst
company: Jobin & Jismi |  Oracle NetSuite Solution provider Partner | SuiteCommerce Expert | VR and 3D
description:
**Company Description**
Jobin & Jismi is an ERP-certified Oracle NetSuite Solution Provider and technology partner specializing in ERP, integrations, AI, eCommerce, and custom web applications. With over a decade of experience and a global client base across multiple industries, the company focuses on transforming complex business processes into connected, efficient, and scalable operations. Jobin & Jismi delivers end-to-end NetSuite services, including implementation, customization, integration, optimization, and SuiteCommerce solutions, as well as implementation rescue support. As a Claude Services Partner and Celigo, Shopify, and SuiteCommerce expert, the team applies practical AI and integration solutions to real business workflows. With teams supporting major global time zones, Jobin & Jismi helps organizations worldwide drive business transformation, intelligent automation, and sustainable growth.

**Role Description**
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a Market Analyst who can support business, sales, and marketing decisions through strong market research and data analytics.

The role involves studying industries, identifying target customer segments, analysing competitors, building lead databases, tracking market trends, and converting raw data into clear business insights. The candidate should be able to work with research data, sales data, marketing performance data, and customer information to support strategy, campaigns, and business growth.

This role is not limited to preparing reports. We are looking for someone who can understand the market, identify opportunities, analyse patterns, and present insights that help the company take better decisions.

**Skills Required**

**Market Research & Opportunity Analysis**

Industry research, competitor benchmarking, market gap analysis, pricing research, TAM/SAM/SOM, ICP creation, customer segmentation, geography mapping, and opportunity mapping.

**Data Analytics & Insight Generation**

Data collection, data cleaning, data validation, data interpretation, trend analysis, correlation analysis, forecasting basics, and business insight generation.

**Sales, Marketing & Customer Analytics**

Lead source analysis, campaign performance analysis, funnel analysis, conversion tracking, CAC analysis, pipeline analysis, customer acquisition trends, retention analysis, churn analysis.

**Tools**

**Data & Analytics Tools:**
Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio.

**Research & Market Intelligence Tools:**
Google Trends, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Crunchbase, MCA Data, ZaubaCorp, industry reports, company websites, and public databases.

**Digital & Marketing Analytics Tools:**
Google Analytics, social media analytics platforms, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Analytics, YouTube Analytics.

**Education**

MBA in Marketing, Business Analytics, Strategy, or related fields preferred.

Candidates with a background in BBA, B.Com, Economics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Engineering, or Computer Applications can also apply if they have strong analytical and research skills.

* Experience: 0-4 years

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
PUMPTEK is a growing organization focused on delivering reliable pumping solutions and related services to a diverse range of customers. The company is committed to quality, customer satisfaction, and building long-term relationships through responsive service and technical support. Team members at PUMPTEK work closely with clients to understand their needs and recommend suitable products and systems. The work environment encourages collaboration, integrity, and continuous learning, offering opportunities to contribute directly to business growth. PUMPTEK aims to expand its presence in the region by strengthening its sales and service network.
  
**Role Description**
The Salesperson role at PUMPTEK is a full-time, on-site position based in Kottayam. The Salesperson will identify and approach prospective customers, present product features and benefits, and provide quotations tailored to client requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include visiting customers, following up on leads, maintaining relationships with existing accounts, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely delivery and after-sales support. The role involves achieving sales targets, maintaining accurate records of inquiries and orders, and preparing basic sales reports. The Salesperson will also participate in local marketing activities, product demonstrations, and training sessions to stay informed about new offerings and industry developments.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and maintain long-term customer relationships.
* Basic knowledge of sales processes, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing deals.
* Ability to understand technical product information and explain it clearly to customers; previous experience in pumps or industrial products is an advantage.
* Comfort with on-site customer visits, field work, and local travel in and around Kottayam.
* Organizational skills for maintaining records, preparing simple reports, and managing multiple inquiries at once.
* Proficiency with common office and communication tools (email, spreadsheets, phone and messaging applications).
* Prior experience in sales or customer-facing roles is preferred; a relevant diploma or degree in business, engineering, or a related field is beneficial.
* Self-motivated, goal-oriented approach, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

title: Insurance Advisor
description:
**Company Description**
HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited is a subsidiary of HDFC Bank Limited, one of India’s leading private sector banks, and is backed by ERGO International AG of the Munich Re Group. The company offers a comprehensive range of general insurance products, including motor, health, travel, home, and personal accident insurance for retail customers, as well as property, marine, and liability solutions for corporate clients. With an extensive branch network and diverse distribution channels, HDFC ERGO serves customers across India. The organization focuses on seamless customer service, innovative products, and round-the-clock support to meet evolving insurance needs. Applicants can expect to join a well-established, growing company with strong international and domestic credentials in the insurance sector.
  
**Role Description**
The Insurance Advisor is a part-time, hybrid role based in Palghat, flexibility to work from home. The role involves advising individuals and businesses on suitable insurance products, explaining coverage options and policy terms, and helping customers select plans that meet their needs and budgets. Daily responsibilities include generating leads, meeting prospective and existing customers, preparing proposals and quotations, and supporting customers through the policy issuance and renewal process. The Insurance Advisor will also assist with claim-related guidance, maintain accurate records of customer interactions, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure high service standards. The role requires consistent achievement of sales and service targets while upholding regulatory and company compliance.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong understanding of Insurance and basic Finance concepts, with the ability to explain products and benefits clearly.
* Experience or aptitude in Customer Service, focused on building long-term relationships and delivering timely support.
* Consulting-oriented mindset, able to assess customer needs and recommend suitable insurance solutions.
* Effective Communication skills, including clear verbal communication and professional writing for proposals and documentation.
* Specialization in finance, business, or related fields is an advantage.
* Prior experience in insurance sales, banking, financial services, or advisory roles is preferred but not mandatory.
* Comfort with using digital tools and CRM systems for lead management and customer follow-up.
* Ability to work with strong ethical standards and adherence to regulatory guidelines.

title: TSI Thrissur
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Sales
  
  
Our Sales teams help to deliver Reckitt's purpose by building shared success with our customers, making access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment possible in-stores and online. Within Sales, we're focused on achieving outperformance across all of our channels, operating in highly competitive categories. This focus results in a dynamic, fast paced environment where cross functional teams are encouraged to collaborate to achieve success. We have around 10,000 sales people across the world, within market roles and ranging in areas like Field Sales, Key Accounts, Trade Marketing and Category Development.
  
  
**About The Role**
Embark on a fulfilling journey as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative with Reckitt. In this position, you'll harness your passion for the healthcare field to introduce life-enhancing pharmaceutical products to professionals who care for patients every day. Armed with a deep understanding of our products and the compassion to make a difference, you'll be the bridge between our breakthrough solutions and the healthcare community. Join us and channel your drive into a career that helps improve lives.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Be the go-to expert for product knowledge, providing insightful information on our pharmaceutical range and its application in therapy areas.
* Meet and exceed sales targets, ensuring Reckitt's pharmaceutical products reach the hands of healthcare providers.
* Develop lasting relationships with healthcare professionals, becoming a reliable source of expertise and support.
* Convey the benefits of our pharmaceutical products through engaging and informative presentations.
* Analyse market data to stay ahead of industry trends, identifying growth opportunities and delivering on them.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* A track record of success in pharmaceutical sales.
* A deep understanding of medical terminologies, products, and therapeutic areas.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect and influence healthcare professionals.
* A proactive approach to building and nurturing relationships with a diverse range of medical authorities.
* Committed to ethical practises and familiar with the regulatory landscape of the pharmaceutical industry.

The skills for success
  
  
Sales Targets, product Knowledge, Customer Relationships, Product Presentations, Market Analysis, Compliance, Territory Management, Training and Development, Sales Reporting, Collaboration.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. title: Client Advisory Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 YESTE Migration \& Education Consulting specializes in Australian visa, migration, and education services for skilled professionals, healthcare workers, students, and businesses. The team provides expert guidance on a wide range of visa categories, including skilled migration, employer\-sponsored visas, student visas, partner visas, and subclasses 407 and 482\. title: Tender Executive
description:
Job Description – Tender Executive
   


**Position Title:** 
 Tender Executive
   




**Department:** 
 Tender
   

**Minimum Qualification:** 
 B.Tech / Diploma / Master’s Degree
   

**Minimum Work Experience:** 
 0–4 years in E\-Tendering, GEM (bidding and price matching), and Tender Management
   

  

 Role Overview
   


 The Tender Executive is responsible for the comprehensive management of the tender process, from initial inquiry to final order acceptance and post\-tender activities. This role demands strong knowledge of tender procedures, market dynamics, and efficient data management to ensure competitive bidding and successful contract awards.
   

  




 Key Responsibilities
   

* **Tender Identification \& Sorting** 
  




	+ Screen and sort tenders / GEM enquiries.
	+ Share relevant opportunities with concerned departments/personnel.
* **Bidding \& Auction Participation** 
  




	+ Actively participate in tender and reverse auction processes.
	+ Identify and apply relevant GEM filters to optimize search and participation.
* **Order Processing \& Price Management** 
  




	+ Process accepted orders efficiently and accurately.
	+ Perform detailed price calculations and workouts to ensure profitability and compliance.
* **Bid Management** 
  




	+ Manage the entire bidding process, including reverse auctions (RA).
	+ Ensure seller information and updates are current and accurate.
* **Data Analysis \& Competitive Review** 
  




	+ Conduct thorough analysis of comparison data.
	+ Identify competitive advantages and areas for improvement in future bids.
* **Catalogue \& Product Management** 
  




	+ Maintain and update product catalogues.
	+ Apply appropriate filters for Level 1 (L1\) comparisons and strategic bidding.
* **Portal Management** 
  




	+ Ensure real\-time updates of stock availability and pricing on the GEM Portal.


 Skills \& Competencies
   

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficiency in GEM portal operations and tender management systems.
* Attention to detail with excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple tenders simultaneously.
* Effective communication and coordination skills across departments.


 Requirements
   

  

 \- Conduct continuous research on tender opportunities, industry trends, and competitor activities to identify and evaluate potential avenues for business growth.
   

 \- Maintain comprehensive and accurate records of all tender\-related documentation, ensuring strict compliance with company policies, legal regulations, and tender specifications.
   

 \- Collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams (e.g., sales, technical, finance, logistics) to gather essential information and facilitate seamless tender execution.
   

 \- Perform detailed analyses of both successful and unsuccessful bids to extract best practices and pinpoint areas for procedural and strategic improvement.
   

 \- Assist in managing and nurturing relationships with key clients and relevant government entities involved in tender processes.
   

 \- Prepare and deliver regular, in\-depth reports on tender status, outcomes, and market intelligence for management review and strategic decision\-making.
   

 \- Proactively identify, propose, and implement enhancements to the tender management process to improve efficiency, compliance, and success rates.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills


**To qualify for the role you must have**
* A bachelor’s degree and 5 to 8 years of relevant work experience
* Achieved, or be working towards a professional designation, such as CTP, CFA, CPA, FRM
* A proven record of problem solving and analytical thinking within a global corporate treasury or consulting business
* Advanced skills and experience with: Treasury organizational structure and transformation, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting, analytics, liquidity management, cash and bank relationship management, international treasury centers, debt and investment management, due diligence, governance and controls, carve outs, and hedge accounting
* The confidence to train and mentor junior colleagues, providing the knowledge, skills and opportunities they need to excel
* Excellent sales and influencing skills, and the ability to present credibly to senior clients and colleagues
* Valid passport required; willingness and ability to travel internationally
* The ability and willingness to travel and work in excess of standard hours when necessary
* Access to reliable transportation to/from the EY office and client sites. A driver’s license is strongly recommended as ride share and public transportation options may not be available in all locations


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A master’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, financial engineering, economics, information technology, information systems, engineering or another relevant discipline
* Certified Treasury Professional qualification
* CFA designation (or CFA candidate)
* Consulting experience on complex projects
* System selection and implementation experience


**What We Look For**
 We’re interested in natural problem\-solvers and leaders, with proven project management and engagement experience. You’ll have the ability to prioritize when working on multiple engagements, as well as the ability to communicate complex information simply and effectively to audiences from all backgrounds. If you’re a global treasury professional looking to further your career as part of a highly collaborative team, this role is for you.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.
   

  

* We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
* 
+ New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $154,000 to $256,700
+ Bay Area California offices – $160,500 to $267,400
+ All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $128,400 to $235,300

In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
